senses.gloss: m. (גדל, v. גְּדִיל) the heap, the difference between stricken and heaped measure.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:9:9">Y. Pes. IV, end, 31ᶜ</cite> [read:] <he>אנא מחשׂכנא ג׳ וכ׳</he> I will deduct the difference from my dowry, v. <cite ref="H01846"><he>חֲשַׂךְ</he></cite>.
